title: Fix: customer's manage-booking page shows the full buffered block instead of the actual massage window
tech: Node/TypeScript backend only -- single query + mapping change in an existing service function; no new endpoint, no frontend change needed since the frontend already just renders whatever start_at_local/end_at_local the backend sends
keyConstraints: Root cause, confirmed by reading backend/src/services/bookingService.ts's createBookingCore: a booking's stored start_at/end_at represent the ENTIRE reserved block -- buffer_before_minutes + duration_minutes + buffer_after_minut -- not just the massage itself (endAt = startAt + (duration_minutes + buffer_before_minutes + buffer_after_minutes)). getBookingForCustomer (same file, ~line 522) formats that raw start_at/end_at directly into CustomerBookingView.startAtLocal/endAtLocal with no adjustment, and frontend/src/pages/ManageBooking.tsx renders them verbatim at line 198 ('{service_name} -- {start_at_local} to {end_at_local}'). For a service with a nonzero buffer_after (e.g. 50 min massage + 30 min buffer_after), the customer sees an 80-minute appointment window instead of the 50-minute one they actually booked. Confirmed via grep that startAtLocal/endAtLocal on CustomerBookingView are used in exactly one place in the frontend (ManageBooking.tsx line 198) -- nowhere else reads or depends on these two fields, so redefining what they represent (massage-only window instead of full buffered block) is safe and requires no frontend changes and no new field names. Fix must account for buffer_before_minutes too, not just buffer_after -- the massage's true start is start_at + buffer_before_minutes, and its true end is that plus duration_minutes; buffer_after_minutes plays no role in the display since it comes after the massage ends. getBookingForCustomer's SQL currently selects only b.start_at, b.end_at, s.id, s.name, p.timezone -- it must additionally select s.duration_minutes and s.buffer_before_minutes to compute this. The existing integration test (test/integration/bookings.customerManagement.test.ts, ~line 45-46) only asserts typeof start_at_local === 'string' -- it provides no regression protection for the actual bug and should be strengthened with a real fixture (a service with nonzero buffer_before and/or buffer_after) asserting the displayed window excludes buffer time.
description: Change getBookingForCustomer (backend/src/services/bookingService.ts) so CustomerBookingView.startAtLocal/endAtLocal reflect only the massage itself, not the full buffered reservation block. Compute the massage's actual start as start_at + buffer_before_minutes, and its end as that plus duration_minutes, then format both through the existing formatLocalTime helper exactly as today. The underlying stored booking (start_at/end_at, the full buffered block) and everything that depends on it for scheduling/availability/conflict-prevention is unchanged -- this is a display-only fix scoped to what the customer sees on their manage-booking page.
acceptanceCriteria: CustomerBookingView.startAtLocal reflects start_at + buffer_before_minutes (the true massage start), not the raw stored start_at
CustomerBookingView.endAtLocal reflects (start_at + buffer_before_minutes + duration_minutes) (the true massage end), not the raw stored end_at
For a service with buffer_before_minutes = 0 (the common case today), the displayed start is unchanged from before -- this fix must not regress the zero-buffer case

A new or strengthened integration test covers a service with nonzero buffer_before_minutes and/or buffer_after_minutes and asserts the displayed startAtLocal/endAtLocal exclude that buffer time -- the existing type-only assertion is not sufficient regression coverage

No change to what's actually stored in the bookings table, to availability computation, to double-booking prevention, or to any other consumer of booking start_at/end_at -- this is scoped entirely to getBookingForCustomer's response shaping
No frontend changes -- ManageBooking.tsx already renders start_at_local/end_at_local verbatim and needs no modification
npm test, npm run build, npm run lint, and tsc --noEmit all pass in backend/ (frontend should be unaffected since no frontend files change)
relevantFilePaths: backend/src/services/bookingService.ts (getBookingForCustomer -- the function to change; createBookingCore -- read-only reference confirming the buffered-block semantics of start_at/end_at)
securityConsiderations: None -- this changes only which local-formatted times are computed for an already-authorized response (customer_booking_tokens possession, unchanged); no new data is exposed and no existing data is hidden, just correctly scoped to what the customer actually booked.
